subject: Can functions call each other in functions block?

messages.author: 33d5534e21fbbe0f
messages.subject: Can functions call each other in functions block?
parts:
Hi, If one wants to define a function in a functions{} block that is, in turn, called by a subsequently defined function, also in the functions{} block, is this permitted?   The first function may be a utility function that would be called in other subsequently defined functions.   In my case, I want to generalize the nearest neighbor GP function of Lu Zhang to the case of vectorized random effects and will do so using a kronecker product.   So I'd like to first define the kronecker product as a function and then, subsequently, use it generalize the nngp_w_l_pdf() function.

Thanks for your help.

Terrance.

--
Thank you, Terrance Savitsky

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Can functions call each other in functions block?
parts:
Yes. They can even call each other recursively if
you forward declare the one that is defined second.
See the manual.

- Bob
